text: Nicholas Joseph LaLota (/ləˈloʊtə/ lə-LOH-tə; born June 23, 1978) is an American politician and veteran who has served since January 7, 2023, as the U.S. representative for New York's 1st congressional district. He is a member of the Republican Party and was born in Bay Shore, New York. LaLota graduated from St. Anthony's High School and earned a degree from the United States Naval Academy in 2000. He served in the U.S. Navy for eight years, including three overseas deployments. He obtained a Master of Business Administration and a Juris Doctor from Hofstra University. LaLota served as chief of staff to Suffolk County presiding officer Kevin McCaffrey, on the Suffolk Board of Elections, and as a trustee for the village of Amityville, New York. He ran for the U.S. House of Representatives in New York's 1st congressional district to succeed Lee Zeldin, who sought the governorship, and won the general election on November 8, 2022, by defeating Democratic nominee Bridget Fleming. On December 27, 2022, LaLota became one of the first Republicans to call for a full House Ethics Committee investigation into false claims made by fellow Long Island Republican George Santos. On March 7, 2024, during President Joe Biden's State of the Union address, Santos announced on social media that he planned to run against LaLota in the 2024 Republican primary. LaLota sought reelection in 2024 and defeated Democratic nominee John Avlon. He is one of six Republicans who signed a bipartisan letter led by centrist House Representatives, pledging to respect the results of the 2024 presidential election. LaLota married his high school sweetheart, Kaylie, who teaches at Northport High School; they have three daughters. He resides in Amityville, New York, and is Catholic.
